card.name: Compatibility check for added drugs
card.fires_on: The word "compatibility" in the IV-fluid and parenteral nutrition instruction to evaluate all additions to the container for compatibility and stability.

modes.label: Additive compatibility instruction
modes.description: "compatibility" after "evaluate all additions to the container for" in IV or parenteral nutrition admixture directions.
modes.example: Evaluate all additions to the plastic container for<< compatibility>> and stability of the resulting preparation.

card.plain: It marks the word "compatibility" in the standard warning to check that added drugs are compatible in an IV bag.
